text:
Bio / Profile


Macro-finance research, public-data systems, and interpretable market-state updating.


I am Jaeseok Hwang, a Ph.D. candidate in Applied Economics at UIUC. My current work centers on a rates and cross-asset scenario updating system that separates prior expectation, structured shock interpretation, realized reaction, covariance-path belief, and ex-post story review.


Open research terminal GitHub LinkedIn




Current role


Applied Economics Ph.D. candidate


Applied macro research, scenario system design, public-data pipelines, and interpretable market diagnostics.




Research object


Scenario path and covariance path


The project tracks how prior beliefs, new shocks, cross-asset reactions, and unresolved gaps evolve through daily, weekly, and monthly horizons.




Current build


Post-close macro scenario terminal


Visual-first dashboard with past path, current node, future forecast branches, covariance diagnostics, and fixed-date review tabs.




Publishing format


Public daily research log


The site is being rebuilt as a recruiter-facing research notebook with daily state updates, weekly reviews, and methods notes.

Macro scenario numeric panel


This right-side panel is the homepage summary view. The full research terminal shows the ensemble tree, date tabs, covariance heatmap, and node-level detail panes.
